info.title: Department of Agriculture Universal API
info.description: Access USDA Economic Research Service Agricultural Resource Management Survey data, including states, years, reports, variables, farm types, categories, and survey result records.

get.description: Retrieves ARMS survey data from Department of Agriculture.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: report
parameters.description: ARMS report number or report name.

schema.description: ARMS report number or report name.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State code/name; provider defaults to all survey states.

schema.description: State code/name; provider defaults to all survey states.

parameters.name: farmType
parameters.description: Farm type filter; provider defaults to All Farms.

schema.description: Farm type filter; provider defaults to All Farms.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Primary ARMS category abbreviation or name.

schema.description: Primary ARMS category abbreviation or name.

parameters.name: categoryValue
parameters.description: Primary category value; provider defaults to Total when category is used.

schema.description: Primary category value; provider defaults to Total when category is used.

parameters.name: category2
parameters.description: Secondary ARMS category abbreviation or name.

schema.description: Secondary ARMS category abbreviation or name.

parameters.name: category2Value
parameters.description: Secondary category value; provider defaults to Total when category2 is used.

schema.description: Secondary category value; provider defaults to Total when category2 is used.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
